tools.name: list_syri_venues
tools.description: Free. Returns every venue RFS currently scores, with pricing, payment terms and data freshness. Venues outside this list return an error and are never charged.

tools.name: get_syri_score
tools.description: PAID: $0.05 USDC on Base per venue, via x402. Returns the risk band (Conservative / Moderate / Speculative) and 0-100 composite. tools.name: get_syri_status
tools.description: Free. Reports whether the service is healthy, which network it settles on, how many venues are scored, and how old the data is. Useful before depending on a score.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_syri_score" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
